liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Summer Wind** (2 other sources): Deaner sang this while the crew swapped out Gener's soaked amp head; Deaner sang it like a Sinatra love song, backed by Glenn's notes, during the amp head swap [2][4]
- **The Enabler $** (2 other sources): Dave sang lead vocals on this one; Dave Dreiwitz handled lead vocals on this song [2][4]

## Setlist highlights

- **38] before first song**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **15] Take Me Away**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **36] Don't Get 2 Close (2 My Fantasy)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **58] Mr. Richard Smoker**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **36] Wavin' My Dick In The Wind**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **15] Voodoo Lady**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **23] Bananas and Blow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **37] Happy Colored Marbles**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]

## The recordings

- **ween2003-09-27** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 142 min [1]
- **ween2003-09-27.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 27 songs; 141 min [2]
- **ween2003-09-27.Matrix.1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 27 songs; 146 min [3]
- **ween2003-09-27.neumann**: source not stated; 27 songs; 141 min [4]

## Around the show

- A person leapt onstage and ran at Gener, making him spill his drink over his amp head [2]
- A fan dumped a drink on Gener's amp head, which had to be replaced mid-show [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2003-09-27**: source: SBD > DAT [1]
- **ween2003-09-27.flac16**: taped by J. Angen; transferred by Cryptical / Lobster; source: Matrix: SBD + Neumann KM140 Mics->Lunatec V2 ->Tascam DAP1 [2]
- **ween2003-09-27.Matrix.1644**: taped by Fireball + Mysterioso; transferred by Fireball; source: MATRIX: SBD Monitor Feed > Unknown DAT > CD-R > WAV (44.1kHz/16 bit) + Schoeps MK4's > Billbox Preamp > Sony M1 > DAT Master (44.1kHz/16 bit) [3]
- **ween2003-09-27.neumann**: taped by J. Angen; transferred by A. Angen; source: Neumann KM140's Mics->LUNATEC V2 ->Tascam DAP1 [4]
